::: {#def-loyalty .theorem}
# Loyalty

We say a component function $g_{ti}$ is loyal to graph $\mathscr{G}$ if for $\mathbf{X},\mathbf{X}' \in \{0,1\}^n$





$$
\begin{equation}
\mathbf{X}_{t\mathscr{N}_i} = \mathbf{X'}_{t\mathscr{N}_i}
\implies 
g_{ti}(\mathbf{X}) = g_{ti}( \mathbf{X'}) 
\end{equation}
$$
:::
